title: The Unwritten Lantern
author: Ulyana Ishikawa
blurb: Edmund Oyelaran, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must choose which family member gets the last berth before the ice breaks on the river.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
